name: mpx/hero-v2
title: Hero V2
description: Hero with a stacked photo + copy on mobile/tablet, and a cinematic full-bleed photo with left brand scrim on desktop.

attributes.label: Background image
attributes.help: Used on tablet and desktop (and on mobile if no mobile image is set). Full-bleed on desktop — prefer a subject framed toward the right.

attributes.label: Mobile image
attributes.help: Optional. Shown only on mobile. If empty, the background image above is used.

attributes.label: Horizontal (desktop)
attributes.help: 0% = left, 100% = right. Used on all breakpoints unless tablet/mobile overrides are enabled.

attributes.label: Vertical (desktop)
attributes.help: 0% = top, 100% = bottom. Used on all breakpoints unless tablet/mobile overrides are enabled.

attributes.label: Custom tablet position
attributes.help: Override image position from tablet up to desktop. Off = use desktop values.

attributes.label: Horizontal (tablet)
attributes.help: 0% = left, 100% = right. Reset to inherit the desktop horizontal value.

attributes.label: Vertical (tablet)
attributes.help: 0% = top, 100% = bottom. Reset to inherit the desktop vertical value.

attributes.label: Custom mobile position
attributes.help: Override image position on mobile. Off = use desktop values.

attributes.label: Horizontal (mobile)
attributes.help: 0% = left, 100% = right. Reset to inherit the desktop horizontal value.

attributes.label: Vertical (mobile)
attributes.help: 0% = top, 100% = bottom. Reset to inherit the desktop vertical value.
